title: dotnet test runner could not bind loopback; tests run via in-process entry point
evidence: _agent_stdout.log item_15: 'The standard dotnet test runner could not open its loopback connection'; BooksApiTests.cs:13 Main() runs the 6 [Fact] methods directly and exits 0 (6/6 passed)
suggestion: No action needed — the in-process runner executes the identical [Fact] methods and is documented in README.md Tests section.

title: ?author= filter matches the full author name (ASCII case-insensitive), not a substring
evidence: BookStore.cs:29 'author = $author COLLATE NOCASE'; BooksApiTests.cs:101 asserts ?author=Butler returns empty for 'Octavia Butler'
suggestion: Spec R3 only requires filtering by the author query param, which exact match satisfies; substring matching would be a behavior choice, not a fix.
